jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Full Stack (EDI)
jobs.description: Who We Are Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. The Role The Workflow Platform team builds Addepar s orchestration layer: a platform, on top of Temporal, that lets other Addepar teams turn long-running, multi-step business processes (approvals, data operations, reporting, client notifications) into reliable, observable, human-in-the-loop workflows. As part of the platform offering we own: Task Centre, where users act on the work workflows assign to them; the Executions view, where teams monitor and manage running workflows; and Client Notifications. We re adding a senior full-stack engineer in Edinburgh. To begin with you ll mostly work on the user-facing side of the platform, and you ll also work on the services behind it. Our engineers work across the stack and in more than one language. Whichever side is newer to you, we ll give you real work there and the support to grow into it. You ll be given high-impact projects to lead end to end, such as a new Task Centre surface, the Executions view, or the components product teams use to build their own task types. You ll work closely with Product and Design to shape what we build, and with our Staff-level tech lead on how we build it, alongside colleagues in Pune and the US and the product teams building on the platform. Our software engineers create and maintain technology and infrastructure that is integral to the success of our trading. Ideal candidates are smart programmers who love to code, are eager to learn, and can thrive in an entrepreneurial environment. We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer with experience designing and managing large environments to fulfill the high-performance and availability requirements of a premiere algorithmic trading firm operating in global financial markets.  This position requires both project management and deep technical skills. Working together with some of the brightest minds in our industry, you’ll be responsible for everything from product selection and design to routing configuration and troubleshooting. You will work closely with our Systems and Trading Operations teams as well as others at HRT to build, manage, and monitor our low-latency trading network. You’ll have broad responsibilities with freedom to analyze and solve problems, and your solutions will have an immediate impact on our worldwide operations.  We’re looking for someone with a love for technology and an excitement for tackling big picture problems. You will work on a wide variety of projects to enhance the performance and capacity of the global trading and research platforms and contribute to both high-level strategy and the technical nitty-gritty of our global network architecture. jobs.title: AI Research Engineer
jobs.description: Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking an AI Research Engineer to join the HAIL team. HAIL (HRT AI Labs) is the team at HRT responsible for developing and maintaining our most powerful models, which are used by our trading teams to drive a significant fraction of our trading. We are building and deploying "foundation models for markets", that ingest and train on vast amounts of market and “alternative” data (such as language) to make predictions about future market state. As a research engineer on HAIL, you will have a general mandate to improve all aspects of large-scale model training, including but not limited to kernel development, training data loading, parallelism, networking, and fault-tolerance. You will work closely with our researchers to co-design and improve our models, and shape the research agenda. We have multiple large, modern, and rapidly growing GPU clusters, and we maintain a very high GPU-to-researcher ratio. We are simultaneously pursuing multiple strategies and developing many model types with different purposes, and we are strongly incentivized to squeeze as much as we can out of our systems. Your work will be directly, clearly, and highly impactful on the business, and it will be challenging: this is a field with no easy or obvious solutions. jobs.title: Senior Consultant - ICS/OT Cybersecurity
jobs.description: At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are  immediately  at risk.  We are the global leader in  xOT  cybersecurity, combining technology, threat intelligence, and expert services. The people here chose this work because they understand  what is  at stake . Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. If safeguarding the systems that protect your family, friends, and community is the kind of work that matters to you, you are in the right place.   About the Role :   As a Senior Consultant on the Professional Services team, you’ll be at the forefront of helping industrial organizations across the UK and EU strengthen their cybersecurity posture. You’ll lead hands-on engagements like architecture reviews, OT cybersecurity assessments, tabletop exercises, and threat baselines for electric, oil and gas, water treatment, chemical, and manufacturing customers. This role blends technical depth with real-world impact: you’ll shape customer strategies and turn lessons learned into smarter tools, playbooks, and stronger defenses. What you learn in the field won’t stay there. You’ll feed it back to our product teams through research, training material, and Dragos Platform playbooks, and represent Dragos in the ICS/OT community. This role is ideal for those passionate about industrial security who want to drive meaningful change. jobs.description: About Black Forest Labs We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We're creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started. Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity. Why this role FLUX models ship as open weights, which gives anyone full access to the model. Our safety efforts focus on suppressing harmful behaviors and mitigating the risk of misuse, so safety has to be built into the models themselves, not bolted on afterwards. As a Member of Technical Staff on our safety research team, you'll research and ship methods that make FLUX models safe by design: from what goes into the training data to how the models are mid- and post-trained, across images, video and the text that conditions them. This is a role with real ownership: you won't just do research on model safety, you'll shape it. The methods you build ship in FLUX models with over 75 million downloads on Hugging Face and in production at some of the largest platforms in the world. jobs.description: Who we are We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves. With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another. Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth. We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands. We’re on the search for... Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it. In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other. The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. We work closely with Product, Social & Community, Creative & Content, CRM, and the PR & Partnerships teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and culturally sharp. This is a nine-month interim contract. The team meets in the office a minimum of twice per week, so you’ll be required to join those days to work alongside your colleagues. Backed by Chaos, our mission is to help brands drive conversion, reduce returns, and deliver inspiring customer experiences. We’re looking for a high-performing Enterprise Account Executive to join our Sales team. This role is focused on landing and expanding strategic accounts in the furniture and home vertical, selling our visualization platform into enterprise manufacturers and retailers. You’ll be responsible for driving new business and managing complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders - from ecommerce and digital teams to product and marketing leaders. Key responsibilities: Own and drive the full sales cycle - from initial outreach through close and expansion Engage with C-level and senior decision-makers at enterprise accounts Understand customer goals and align Cylindo’s platform to solve high-impact problems Collaborate with solution engineers, marketing, and customer success to deliver value throughout the sales process Accurately forecast and manage pipeline using HubSpot CRM and MEDDPICC methodology Meet or exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets 5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with 3+ years in complex, enterprise-level sales Experience selling to ecommerce, digital, or IT stakeholders Background in PIM (Product Information Management), DAM (Digital Asset Management), CMS, or ecommerce platforms (e.g., Shopify, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce) strongly preferred Proven track record of quota attainment and strategic deal execution Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong executive presence Based in or near Boston (MA) or London (UK) area preferred Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

jobs.description: gravity9 is recruiting Java engineers and architects for a portfolio of engagements across UK central government. These are large-scale, data-intensive modernisation programmes: replacing legacy systems that carry statutory weight, decomposing monoliths that serve millions of users, and building secure data platforms where access control and auditability are first-class architectural concerns rather than late additions. We are hiring across two overlapping profiles — Senior Java Developer and Application / Migration Architect — and expect most people to move between programmes as engagements start and complete. Several of these are hands-on architect roles: you will own design decisions and also write production code The kind of work The following are representative of current and upcoming engagements. Individual roles will draw on some of this, not all of it — we are more interested in engineers who can work confidently at the intersection of Java and data than in a checklist match against any one programme. Secure data catalogue and access-control platform A greenfield metadata catalogue acting as a federated index over data held across independent domains, so that authorised parties can locate and retrieve data the catalogue itself never holds. jobs.title: Développeur fullstack confirmé H/F (C#, .Net, Angular)
jobs.description: À propos de N2JSoft N2JSoft est une Fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la gestion des dépenses professionnelles. Fondée en 2015, elle compte aujourd’hui 20 000 clients et 1M utilisateurs dans 98 pays , faisant de N2F l’un des leaders du marché français. N2F simplifie la gestion des frais professionnels : photo des justificatifs, reconnaissance automatique, validation, export comptable, archivage à valeur probante , etc. L’objectif : faire gagner du temps aux entreprises tout en sécurisant leurs processus internes. Après une croissance progressive, l’équipe est passée de 20 personnes en 2021 à 230 aujourd’hui , portée par le succès produit et l’expansion internationale. Nous partageons un objectif commun : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des notes de frais et des factures fournisseurs. En 2021, N2JSoft a élargi son expertise avec Keeple , un logiciel RH dédié aux congés, absences et temps de travail (hors périmètre de ce poste). Quelques chiffres 230 collaborateurs , dont 50 dans l'équipe tech Notre site est basé à Montagnat (01) avec un format de télétravail hybride ou full remote. L’équipe tech Notre équipe est composée de développeurs/euses full stack expérimenté(e)s , réparti(e)s en squads : Notes de frais, Cartes de paiement pro, Invoices, Core… Chaque squad réunit : développeurs/euses, tech lead, team lead, product manager et testeur/euses QA. Stack et pratiques Front : Angular 16/21 Back : .NET 10 – C# Infra : AWS BDD : MSSQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB Architecture : monolithe modulaire Bonnes pratiques : tests unitaires, revues de code, pair programming, couverture Qodana, Microsoft Release Flow. Méthodo : Agile Scrum, sprints de 2 semaines (daily, weekly, rétro, planning). Le profil recherché Rattaché(e) à un(e) Team Lead dans l'une des squads produit, tu disposes : D'une formation en informatique Bac+3 minimum De 3 ans d’expérience en .NET / C# (web ou backend) De 2 ans d'expérience sur Angular et de bonnes connaissances front-end (HTML/CSS, TypeScript)

jobs.title: UI Designer - Casual Games (Freelance Remote)
jobs.description: We’re looking for a UI designer who loves casual games. You know what makes a game feel intuitive and fun to play, and you can turn that into clean, good-looking UI. You’ll be assisting the SOHO Art team and reporting directly to our Game Art Lead. Heads up: we’ll ask you to do a short graphics assignment as part of the process. What you’ll be doing: Creating UI assets - designing visually appealing interfaces that align with the game’s art direction. Matching our style - we have a very specific look. You’ll study it and create new elements that feel like part of the same family, so everything fits right in next to what we already have. Using AI tools - speeding up your work with AI: quick ideas, variations, and rough explorations. Then you polish the final assets by hand until they meet our quality bar. Helping out with general art - characters, backgrounds, props, and other 2D assets when needed. Taking feedback and running with it - we iterate a lot, and quick, smooth revisions make everyone’s life easier. Owning your work - you decide how to scope it, prioritise it, and deliver it, without needing someone to hold your hand. What we’re looking for: Experience working on casual games. Strong UI design and execution skills, with good UX instincts. Excellent 2D art skills. Strong portfolio showcasing high-quality UI art for mobile titles from concept to final in-game execution. The ability to work independently and figure out unclear problems, while taking on board feedback from the Game Art Lead. Good English so that you can explain your design decisions clearly to people from different teams. Solid skills in standard design tools like Figma and Photoshop (or similar). Comfort in a small team, where you’ll wear a few hats and switch between big-picture thinking and hands-on work. Nice to have: Any UI animation skills. Passion for games and player psychology. jobs.title: (Freelance) Chargé·e de relations clients e-commerce
jobs.description: [Freelance, en télétravail] Circles est une marque française DTC qui propose des solutions naturelles pour l'équilibre hormonal féminin, des premières règles à la ménopause : compléments alimentaires, cosmétiques naturels et contenus éducatifs. Notre mission ? Éduquer et informer sur l'équilibre hormonal féminin, tout en proposant des produits naturels et clés en main pour accompagner chaque étape du cycle. En 5 ans, plus de 200 000 clientes nous ont fait confiance. Circles est aujourd'hui présente en ligne et en pharmacie en France, ainsi qu'en Italie. jobs.description: Become a Part of Accurids Join us and help shape the future of pharmaceutical data! At Accurids, we build the data backbone behind life-science innovation. You raise security awareness across the team through trainings and clear guidelines. Enabled through AI, we are turning this often-painful process into a radically simple experience for our customers, so they can focus on what matters to them: growing their business. jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Developer Tools (Starcraft)
jobs.description: We are hiring a software engineering manager with a passion for developer experience and build tooling to have a positive impact on the day-to-day workflow of thousands of snap and charm publishers. To be successful on this team you'll need to be interested in packaging formats, build systems and automation that can simplify the lives of developers and engineers trying to ship software to the widest possible audience. We design and maintain specialist Python tools to support the developer build and publication process. The team takes responsibility for tooling that builds snaps , charms and more recently, rocks ( OCI images ). Snapcraft allows developers to deliver app updates to millions of Linux systems automatically, eliminating the long tail of supported releases and complex install instructions. Snapcraft enables thousands of applications from over a thousand developers, including well-recognized names like Spotify, Slack, and Microsoft. Likewise, Charmcraft enables collaboration between charmed operator developers, and publication on Charmhub , home of the Charmed Operator Collection. Charmed Operators enable developers to package software like databases, event queues, caches, observability tools, identity tools and more, right alongside the operations code that enables teams to integrate and operate that software at scale from Day 0 to Day 1,000, and beyond. Your primary responsibility is to your team: helping them grow as engineers, do important and satisfying work, and have a great time while doing it. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. jobs.description: PT Bank Tabungan Negara (Persero) Tbk atau lebih sering dikenal dengan Bank BTN, merupakan perusahaan BUMN (Badan Usaha Milik Negara) yang bergerak dibidang Perbankan. Perusahaan ini berkomitmen menjadi Bank yang melayani dan mendukung pembiayaan sektor perumahan melalui tiga produk utama, perbankan perseorangan, bisnis dan syariah. jobs.description: ImaginePartners recherche, pour l’un de ses clients, un testeur QA fonctionnel (H/F) pour une mission de 6 mois à mi-temps . Vous interviendrez sur plusieurs projets d’évolution du système d’information, dans un environnement principalement Microsoft. Votre rôle sera de valider les applications avant leur mise en production, de la préparation des tests à la vérification des corrections. Modalités de la mission Démarrage — Dès que possible Durée — 6 mois Rythme — Mi-temps, avec une répartition des jours à convenir Localisation — Région de Marseille, avec possibilité de travailler à distance TJM — À proposer Vos missions Analyser les besoins métiers et les spécifications, identifier les parcours à tester et définir la stratégie de test de chaque projet. Concevoir les scénarios, les cas de test et les jeux de données. Préparer et maintenir les plans de test. Exécuter les tests fonctionnels, d’intégration, de non-régression et de bout en bout. Participer aux campagnes de recette avant les mises en production. Qualifier et documenter les anomalies, suivre leur correction avec les développeurs et effectuer les contre-tests. Prioriser les campagnes entre les projets, communiquer les résultats aux équipes métiers et techniques et contribuer à harmoniser les pratiques de test. Profil recherché Vous avez une expérience significative en tests logiciels ou en recette fonctionnelle d’applications web ou de systèmes d’information d’entreprise. Vous savez mener une campagne de test en autonomie, documenter vos résultats et gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle. Vous avez utilisé Azure DevOps, Jira ou un outil équivalent, dans un environnement Agile/Scrum ou en cycle en V. Une expérience sur Power Platform, Dynamics 365 ou SharePoint , la certification ISTQB Foundation et la pratique de l’ automatisation des tests sont appréciées. jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs.description: About Us Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to coordinate repairs, maintenance, and contractor workflows at scale. The platform combines a marketplace, workflow automation, and operational analytics, and is built to handle the volume and compliance demands of social housing, local authority property portfolios, and large-scale residential operations. We are headquartered in London and our team works across Europe. We are growing the team to expand the platform's coverage across Europe and to integrate AI throughout the product and operating model. If you are interested in working on hard, real-world problems in a sector that has long been under-served by good software, we would like to hear from you. The Role We are hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer to build the product surfaces that housing providers, contractors, and residents use every day. This is a fully remote position; we currently have remote engineers based in the UK, Germany, Turkey, Poland, Italy, Spain, and Portugal. You will report to a Team Lead, a hands-on engineer who still writes code and has a small number of engineers reporting to them, and work alongside product managers, designers, backend engineers, and data analysts. Our frontend is built on TypeScript, React, React Router, TanStack Query, MaterialUI and BaseUI, against an increasingly service-oriented backend built in Django REST Framework and PostgreSQL. The codebase is large but clean, because we put real weight on design patterns, readability, testability, maintainability, and extendability. The engineering team sits at the centre of what Plentific does, and the problems are genuinely difficult: online payments, quoting, invoicing, booking, search and scoring algorithms, in-app messaging, real-time notifications, and fraud prevention. jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, Energy & Defence
jobs.description: Finance Deserves Better Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on a patchwork of legacy ERPs and point solutions. Every new entity, project or tool adds another system to stitch together and another hire to keep the numbers reconciled. Light gives them a way out. We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one: Our ledger records every transaction across every entity in real time, so the numbers hold up from day one. Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting. Our agents operate the repetitive work that used to need another hire, so finance teams spend their time on the decisions that matter. Today we run the finance function for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot, with backing from Atomico, Balderton, Seedcamp, Cherry and Entrée. Now we’re taking Light into specific industries, with the ambition of becoming the operating layer each one runs on. Energy and defence sit among our priority sectors. The Role We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to go deep on energy and defence and work out how Light wins there. Energy developers, operators and service businesses share a lot with defence technology and service suppliers. Both run on project and contract economics, both report across several entities, and both face long, multi-stakeholder buying cycles where auditability and approvals carry real weight. Your job is to understand these buyers better than anyone at Light, turn what you learn into positioning and proof our sales team can use, and build the playbook we follow to scale our go-to-market across both sectors. You’ll sit in our product marketing team and work side by side with the Sales Managers who cover these sectors, with support from demand generation, field marketing and product. jobs.title: AI & Revenue Operations Lead
jobs.description: Light brings together the ledger, apps tailored to individual businesses and AI agents that carry out finance workflows. We are building the financial foundation for companies operating across entities, currencies and industries. We are looking for an ambitious leader with practical AI expertise, sharp commercial judgement and the ability to turn strategy into execution. Working directly with the VP Sales, you will help shape where we invest, identify what holds us back and build the systems that move us forward. You will be a close strategic and execution partner: prepared, proactive and comfortable challenging constructively. Bring a clear point of view, turn decisions into owners and deadlines, and drive work across teams through to adoption. What you’ll own AI and automation. Build reliable AI agents and connected workflows for account research, meeting intelligence, opportunity inspection, follow-ups, forecasting and reporting. Connect models to business data and systems, evaluate accuracy and measure the time saved and commercial impact. Growth planning and market intelligence. Partner with GTM and Finance on territories, capacity, hiring, quotas and investment. Identify patterns in the customers we win and the problems they buy us to solve. Turn regional, industry and partner opportunities into credible operating plans. Revenue performance and board reporting. Own a trusted view of pipeline, conversion, win rates, sales cycles, productivity, retention and expansion. Help the VP Sales and Finance prepare the commercial board pack, translating performance and forecasts into a clear narrative and recommendations. Participate in relevant board discussions as required. Sales execution and systems. Improve HubSpot, lead routing, attribution, data quality and handoffs across Lead → Close → Renew → Expand. Embed MEDDIC, stage gates, economic buyer engagement, pricing approvals and forecast discipline. Make direct and partner performance visible. Leadership and scale.

jobs.title: Founding Implementation Manager (Italian Speaking)
jobs.description: About Sona Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them. Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here . About the Role We're hiring a Founding Implementation Manager to lead how Sona implements in Italy. You'll be the first person doing this job in the market, and you'll own every Italian implementation from kick-off to go-live. In the UK, our implementations follow an established playbook. In Italy there isn't one yet, so working out how we do this well is part of the job. Expect a lot of unknowns and plans that change. You'll build a clear picture of the lay of the land, take the route that gets us there fastest and bring in the right people from Product, Commercial, our customers and local specialists when they're needed. Day to day, that means keeping a lot of moving parts pointed in the same direction, with stakeholders across our customers, Product and the wider Sona team, and relationships that are rarely simple. Du bekommst keine fertige IT-Abteilung mit hundert Tickets, sondern eine echte Pionierrolle: Du legst das Fundament für unser Data Warehouse und machst aus verstreuten Daten echtes Wissen für Disposition, Fuhrpark und Geschäftsführung. Du automatisierst Routinearbeiten wie Rechnungsprüfung, Auswertungen und Reports. Du bist erste Ansprechperson für KI im Haus: Du schulst Kolleginnen und Kollegen, sammelst Ideen und machst daraus funktionierende Lösungen. Du hast Datenschutz und Datensicherheit immer im Blick. Echte Begeisterung für KI und Large Language Models – und Lust, sie praktisch einzusetzen statt nur darüber zu reden. Generalisten-Gen: Du packst gern selbst an, von der Datenbank bis zum Gespräch mit der Disposition. Erfahrung in Logistik oder mit Soloplan ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss – auch Berufseinsteiger sind herzlich willkommen, wir geben dir Zeit zum Reinwachse

We embed deeply with customers to solve high-leverage problems and act as the delivery engine for our most complex large-scale engagements. We move quickly from prototype to production and surface reusable patterns that shape our platform. We operate at the intersection of deployment and development – working closely with OpenAI Research, Product and Partnerships. About the Role As a Deployment Lead, you will define how OpenAI delivers complex systems to Semiconductor customers. You will own how solutions are scoped, built, shipped, and adopted across high-value engineering workflows such as RTL design, verification, and physical implementation. You’ll translate business outcomes into a technical plan, run day-to-day execution across FDEs, Researchers, and Customer Engineers, and partner with customer teams to ensure delivery supports their goals. You will focus on the semiconductor vertical to deploy next-generation AI capabilities. You will own delivery end-to-end: embedding with customers to map workflows and success criteria, ensuring components ship on time, and leading readiness and change management for adoption. You’ll track progress, manage dependencies, make sequencing decisions, and drive 0→1 prototypes through MVP and scale. Success will be measured first and foremost by impact - deployments that deliver measurable value against customer goals, drive adoption, and become critical to their workflows. Additional measures of success include delivery reliability (milestones hit, low reopen/churn), operating leverage (patterns reused across deployments), judgment under pressure, and product impact (field signal that shifts roadmaps/architectures). This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role. Success requires deep technical project management expert

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), Cyber - London
jobs.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team builds with customers to bring frontier AI into production. Our Cyber FDEs partner with the security and engineering teams that defend globally critical systems, from enterprise software to the core infrastructure it runs on. Cyber FDEs work closely with our Product, Research, and Go-to-Market teams to adapt our products and models to what customers need to defend their systems. About the Role You’ll build systems that give defenders an advantage at a scale few engineering teams encounter. You might help an enterprise identify, test, and deploy patches across hundreds of thousands of code repositories, or help a security team analyze petabytes of logs for signs of malicious agents or coordinated attacks. Across these deployments, you’ll build tools that customer engineers can trust to support consequential security decisions. You’ll work directly with customer security teams, from CISOs to frontline analysts. As AI changes how attackers operate, you’ll help these teams determine where their defenses need to evolve, prioritize what to build, and validate solutions with the engineers who will operate them. Alongside OpenAI’s account teams, you’ll translate security priorities into deployed systems that help defenders cover more ground. You’ll also help shape what OpenAI builds next. When you identify a gap between what defenders need and what today’s models or products can do, you’ll partner with Research and Product to define, build, and test capabilities that address it. This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required. In this role you will: Partner with customer security leaders and OpenAI’s Go-to-Market team to scope engagements, establish responsibilities, and define measurable success criteria. Regular travel to Hamburg and to clinical sites, about 2 to 4 days per month. Reports to: CTO About the venture: ROB E ROB E is a Hamburg-based medtech startup and part of the NLC Health Ventures portfolio. We are developing a robotic system that holds and steers a standard transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) probe during structural heart interventions. Interventionalists get stable, reproducible echo views, and echocardiographers no longer have to stand next to the patient in the X-ray field. Our first-generation prototype has been used in a first-in-human study with published results. We are now developing the next generation from scratch as a fully compliant medical device for CE marking and FDA clearance. The team includes a CTO, a System Software Architect and a Head of Quality & Regulatory. The role You are the mechatronic design authority of ROB E. You own the system architecture, the hardware requirements and the technical decisions for the mechanics, drives, sensing and electronics of our robot. You work on site with our engineering development partner in the Maastricht area and steer their team on our behalf. This is a hands-on senior role: you design yourself, review the work of others and make sure the hardware is safe, verifiable and ready for design transfer. Responsibilities Define and own the mechatronic system architecture: robotic device, drives, force and torque sensing, real-time controllers, safety supervisor, power supply and the interface to commercial TEE probes. jobs.title: Control & Estimation Intern
jobs.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on. These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation. Your mission The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions. Responsibilities Literature review: Survey existing approaches to disturbance estimation and adaptive control Algorithm implementation: Develop and implement the selected estimation and compensation algorithms within our simulation environment. Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and robustness of the developed methods against classical baselines. Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution

Grâce à ce travail, les équipes produit livrent sans risque, tandis que les coûts, la latence et la sécurité restent sous contrôle. Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. jobs.title: CDI - Senior AI Strategist - Paris
jobs.description: Prenez en main un stream de transformation IA, au contact direct des clients, de la vision aux résultats mesurables. L’IA, et en particulier l’IA agentique, figure parmi les priorités des comités de direction. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers. “We Make AI Work” : notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, à grande échelle, au cœur des grands groupes.  Et tout commence par vous.   Mission En tant que Senior AI Strategist , vous prenez en main un stream ou une mission bien cadrée, avec autonomie sur votre périmètre et au contact direct des clients : vous cadrez, analysez, prototypez et recommandez, vous coachez les consultants juniors, et vous voyez vos recommandations prendre vie avec nos équipes Engineering. Vous commencez là où débute toute transformation IA : par l’ambition du client, son secteur d’activité et ses processus métier, et non par la technologie. Et vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous construisez vous-même analyses, business cases et démos fonctionnelles (vibe coding, low-code, no-code) que le client peut toucher, et vous développez un domaine d’expertise solide dans un secteur ou une fonction métier. Vous travaillez main dans la main avec nos équipes Engineering (qui construisent et livrent des solutions d’IA agentique) et nos équipes AI Adoption (qui favorisent leur adoption) : vous cadrez les processus cibles et la roadmap de votre stream, Engineering les construit et les livre, et AI Adoption accompagne les personnes dans le changement, dès le premier jour. Activités & Responsabilités Conception de la stratégie et de la transformation IA Vous contribuez à cadrer la vision IA et à la roadmap du stream, qualifiez et priorisez les cas d’usage, et arbitrez entre solutions IA et non-IA. jobs.title: CDI - Senior AI Strategist - Paris
jobs.description: Prenez en main un stream de transformation IA, au contact direct des clients, de la vision aux résultats mesurables. L’IA, et en particulier l’IA agentique, figure parmi les priorités des comités de direction. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers. “We Make AI Work” : notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, à grande échelle, au cœur des grands groupes.  Et tout commence par vous.   Mission En tant que Senior AI Strategist , vous prenez en main un stream ou une mission bien cadrée, avec autonomie sur votre périmètre et au contact direct des clients : vous cadrez, analysez, prototypez et recommandez, vous coachez les consultants juniors, et vous voyez vos recommandations prendre vie avec nos équipes Engineering. Vous commencez là où débute toute transformation IA : par l’ambition du client, son secteur d’activité et ses processus métier, et non par la technologie. Et vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous construisez vous-même analyses, business cases et démos fonctionnelles (vibe coding, low-code, no-code) que le client peut toucher, et vous développez un domaine d’expertise solide dans un secteur ou une fonction métier. Vous travaillez main dans la main avec nos équipes Engineering (qui construisent et livrent des solutions d’IA agentique) et nos équipes AI Adoption (qui favorisent leur adoption) : vous cadrez les processus cibles et la roadmap de votre stream, Engineering les construit et les livre, et AI Adoption accompagne les personnes dans le changement, dès le premier jour. Activités & Responsabilités Conception de la stratégie et de la transformation IA Vous contribuez à cadrer la vision IA et à la roadmap du stream, qualifiez et priorisez les cas d’usage, et arbitrez entre solutions IA et non-IA. Vous investiguez les processus métier, identifiez les irritants et les causes racines, et proposez des pistes de refonte priorisées, en pensant d’abord lean et en n’utilisant l’IA que là où elle

Omdat ons team groeit, krijg je veel ruimte om mee te bouwen aan onze propositie én aan je eigen ontwikkeling. Dit ga je doen Je stuurt complexe transformatieprogramma’s aan Een transformatieconsultant begeleidt organisaties bij fundamentele veranderingen die verder gaan dan een gewone reorganisatie of procesverbetering. jobs.title: macOS & Jamf Automation Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a hands-on macOS & Jamf Automation Engineer to engineer, automate and continuously improve the services that support our global Apple device estate. This role is focused on delivering a secure, reliable and consistent macOS experience at scale through Jamf Pro, reusable code, APIs and modern engineering practices. You will replace repetitive administration and one-off scripts with maintainable automation for device enrolment, configuration, application delivery, patching, compliance and lifecycle management. Working across Jamf Pro, Apple Business Manager, identity, security, asset and service-management platforms, you will build integrations and workflows that make Apple device services easier to operate, measure and support. Engineering mindset Automation is the product, not an afterthought. We are looking for someone who sees a manual Jamf task, fragile policy or recurring Mac support issue and asks, “How can we make this reliable, reusable and self-service?” You should be comfortable working from Apple and Jamf documentation, investigating unfamiliar behaviours and translating operational requirements into production-quality automation. Your solutions account for failure, test changes before release, scale to an enterprise environment, provide useful telemetry and favour reusable frameworks over isolated scripts. jobs.description: Waarom pak je in de supermarkt het ene product wel uit het schap en het andere niet? Ligt het aan de verpakking? De prijs? Smaak? Gemak? Of simpelweg omdat het precies op de juiste plek staat? Bij Growy telen we verse sla, kruiden en microgreens in Amsterdam in onze vertical farm. Vertical farming klinkt misschien ingewikkeld, maar het idee is simpel: we telen planten in lagen boven elkaar, midden in de stad en helemaal los van het weer buiten. Nu onze producten in steeds meer Nederlandse supermarkten te vinden zijn, willen we onze consumenten nóg beter leren begrijpen. Daarom zoeken we een nieuwsgierige en commercieel ingestelde stagiair die zich wil verdiepen in consumentengedrag en inzichten kan vertalen naar echte commerciële kansen. En nee, dit wordt geen stageproject wat ergens in een lade verdwijnt en niemand ooit nog bekijkt, jouw stage gaat voor ons echt een verschil maken! 🌱 Wat ga je doen? Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat meer consumenten Growy ontdekken, proberen én opnieuw kopen? Tijdens je stage ga je bijvoorbeeld: consumenten interviewen en/of focusgroepen organiseren; onderzoeken wat mensen belangrijk vinden bij het kopen van verse salades en kruiden; ontdekken welke drempels consumenten ervan weerhouden een product te proberen; onderzoeken wat juist zorgt voor een herhaalaankoop; kijken naar kansen rondom prijs, assortiment, verpakking, positionering, promoties en zichtbaarheid; kwantitatief onderzoek, zoals enquêtes, opzetten om ideeën te testen; jouw inzichten vertalen naar concrete commerciële en marketingaanbevelingen. Aan het einde van je stage presenteer je jouw belangrijkste inzichten en aanbevelingen aan ons Sales & Marketing team. jobs.description: We are looking for a Customer Sales Associate to provide attentive, knowledgeable, and personalized customer service. This position will be reporting to work at SM City Bacoor . You will report directly to the Store Supervisor. Key responsibilities: Customer Engagement and Service Delivery Welcome and acknowledge customers in a warm, respectful, and professional manner. Observe customer behaviour and offer assistance at an appropriate time without creating unnecessary pressure Understand customer needs through relevant questions and active listening. Handle routine customer inquiries and refer concerns requiring authorization to the Store Head. Assist with product selection, fitting-room requirements, alternative sizes, and styling options. Maintain appropriate customer privacy, comfort, and professional boundaries. Apply customer engagement techniques that support conversion, ATV, UPT, and other approved KPIs. Participate in daily sales briefings and understand assigned productivity objectives. Respond constructively to coaching and implement agreed improvements. Balance sales productivity with the brand’s non-hard-selling service philosophy. Replenish merchandise and maintain correct product placements, size arrangement, and display standards. Ensure

jobs.title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$400-US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$400-US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience

jobs.title: Rekrutmen Frontliner Teller dan Customer Service Bank BCA Syariah
jobs.description: PT Bank BCA Syariah (BCA Syariah) adalah lembaga perbankan syariah di Indonesia. Berdiri dan mulai melaksanakan kegiatan usaha dengan prinsip-prinsip syariah setelah memperoleh izin operasi syariah dari Bank Indonesia berdasarkan Keputusan Gubernur BI No 12/13/KEP GBI/DpG/2010 tanggal 2 Maret 2009 dan kemudian resmi beroperasi sebagai bank syariah pada hari Senin tanggal 5 April 2010. saat ini PT Bank BCA Syariah sedang buka lowongan kerja terbaru. BCA Syariah mencanangkan untuk menjadi pelopor dalam industri perbankan syariah Indonesia sebagai bank yang unggul di bidang penyelesaian pembayaran, penghimpun dana dan pembiayaan bagi nasabah bisnis dan perseorangan. Masyarakat yang menginginkan produk dan jasa perbankan yang berkualitas serta ditunjang oleh kemudahan akses dan kecepatan transaksi merupakan target dari BCA Syariah. Jaringan cabang BCA Syariah tersebar di wilayah DKI Jakarta, Tangerang, Bogor, Depok, Bekasi, Surabaya, Semarang, Bandung, Solo, Yogyakarta, Medan, Palembang, Malang, Lampung, Banda Aceh, Kediri, Pasuruan, dan Panakkukang. jobs.title: Rekrutmen Pegawai Administrasi Tidak Tetap (PATT) BPJS Kesehatan
jobs.description: Badan Penyelenggara Jaminan Sosial ( BPJS ) Kesehatan adalah badan hukum yang dibentuk untuk menyelenggarakan program jaminan kesehatan sebagaimana diamanatkan dalam Undang-Undang Nomor 40 Tahun 2004 Tentang Sistem Jaminan Sosial Nasional dan Undang-Undang Nomor 24 Tahun 2011 tentang Badan Penyelenggara Jaminan Sosial yang bertugas untuk menyelenggarakan jaminan Kesehatan Nasional bagi seluruh rakyat Indonesia. Berikut ini adalah Rekrutmen Pegawai Administrasi Tidak Tetap BPJS Kesehatan. BPJS Kesehatan mulai resmi beroperasi pada 1 Januari 2014. Dasar pendirian beroperasinya BPJS Kesehatan adalah pada tahun 2004 pemerintah mengeluarkan UU Nomor 40 Tahun 2004 tentang Sistem Jaminan Sosial Nasional (SJSN) dan kemudian pada tahun 2011 pemerintah menetapkan UU Nomor 24 Tahun 2011 tentang Badan Penyelenggara Jaminan Sosial (BPJS). Visi: Menjadi badan penyelenggara yang dinamis, akuntabel, dan terpercaya untuk mewujudkan jaminan kesehatan yang berkualitas, berkelanjutan, berkeadilan, dan inklusif. Rekrutmen Pegawai Administrasi Tidak Tetap BPJS Kesehatan Saat ini BPJS Kesehatan membuka rekrutmen lowongan kerja untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: 1. Pegawai Administrasi Tidak Tetap (PATT) Staf Kedeputian Wilayah dan Kantor Cabang Job Description Pegawai Administrasi Tidak Tetap (PATT) adalah Pegawai Tidak Tetap yang direkrut untuk mendukung pelaksanaan fungsi organisasi BPJS Kesehatan sesuai dengan kebutuhan unit kerja. Sebagai PATT Staf, Anda akan berperan dalam mendukung kegiatan operasional, administrasi, serta tugas-tugas lain sesuai dengan bidang dan kebutuhan unit kerja penempatan. Ruang lingkup tugas akan disesuaikan dengan jabatan dan unit kerja masing-masing. jobs.description: Dana Pensiun Astra adalah Dana Pensiun yang didirikan oleh Astra International yang difungsikan sebagai pengelola Manfaat Pensiun dari karyawan Astra Group. Semula didirikan tahun 1986 oleh founder PT Astra International Tbk yaitu Bapak William Soeryadjaya dan keluarganya, dengan nama Yayasan Dana Pensiun Astra yang berkedudukan di Jakarta berdasarkan akta Notaris Ny. Rukmasanti Hardjasatya, SH nomor 70 tanggal 22 Desember. Berikut ini Lowongan Kerja Dana Pensiun Astra Terbaru. Filosofi dasar dari founder adalah kesejahteraan sosial yang layak bagi karyawan di hari tuanya. Bahwa untuk mencapai kesejahteraan sosial ini diperlukan adanya usaha bersama untuk memupuk dana sebagai bekal hidup yang layak bagi Karyawan dan atau keluarganya pada waktu memasuki masa pensiun atau bila meninggal dunia. Pada tahun 2005, dilakukan pemisahan Dana Pensiun Astra menjadi Dana Pensiun Astra Satu (DPA Satu) yang menyelenggarakan Program Pensiun Manfaat Pasti dan Dana Pensiun Astra Dua (DPA Dua) yang menyelenggarakan Program Pensiun Iuran Pasti. Kedua Dana Pensiun tersebut telah disahkan oleh Menteri Keuangan pada tanggal 6 September 2005. Lowongan Kerja Dana Pensiun Astra Saat ini Dana Pensiun Astra membuka rekrutmen lowongan kerja untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: Secretary Bertanggung jawab dalam mengelola administrasi, korespondasi, dokumen, serta pengaturan agenda direksi guna mendukung kelancaran kegiatan operasional. Setelah sanggup memenuhi pasar Indonesia, Perseroan melakukan Penawaran Umum Perdana dan menjadi perusahaan publik pada tahun 1990 dengan target market; konsumen Asean. Kemudian melebarkan sayapnya ke negara negara di Asia. Dan saat ini produk Perseroan telah tersebar di 5 benua di dunia. Bisnis ini berkembang dan Grup Mayora kemudian secara resmi didirikan pada tahun 1977 dan sejak itu telah berkembang menjadi perusahaan global yang diakui dalam industri Fast Moving Consumer Goods. jobs.title: Rekrutmen Pegawai Pemerintah Non Pegawai Negeri (PPNPN) KPP Pratama
jobs.description: Kantor Pelayanan Pajak atau KPP adalah salah satu unit atau cabang dari Direktorat Jenderal Pajak di Indonesia. Kantor ini bertugas untuk memberikan pelayanan terkait perpajakan kepada wajib pajak yang berada di wilayahnya. Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Pratama biasanya melayani wajib pajak yang memiliki jenis usaha atau perorangan dengan volume transaksi yang lebih kecil dibandingkan dengan kantor pajak yang lebih besar seperti Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Besar. Penerimaan Pegawai Pemerintah Non Pegawai Negeri (PPNPN) KPP Pratama. Tugas utama Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Pratama adalah mengumpulkan, mengelola, dan memberikan informasi serta panduan kepada wajib pajak mengenai peraturan perpajakan, pelaporan pajak, serta pembayaran pajak. Mereka juga melakukan pemeriksaan pajak untuk memastikan kepatuhan wajib pajak terhadap aturan perpajakan. Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Pratama ini biasanya tersebar di berbagai wilayah di seluruh Indonesia untuk memudahkan wajib pajak dalam mengakses layanan perpajakan tanpa harus pergi ke kantor pajak yang lebih besar. Tujuannya adalah untuk meningkatkan kepatuhan perpajakan dan memfasilitasi wajib pajak dalam memenuhi kewajibannya terkait pajak. Lowongan Kerja Kantor Pelayanan Pajak (KPP) Pratama Saat ini KPP Pratama Majene membuka lowongan kerja untuk posisi Pramubakti untuk mendukung pelaksanaan tugas dan fungsi KPP Pratama. jobs.title: Rekrutmen Officer Development Program (ODP) Bank Syariah Nasional (BSN)
jobs.description: PT Bank Syariah Nasional (BSN) merupakan institusi perbankan syariah yang berkomitmen menghadirkan layanan keuangan yang amanah, inovatif, dan berkelanjutan sesuai prinsip syariah. Rekrutmen Officer Development Program Bank Syariah Nasional (BSN). PT Bank Syariah Nasional (BSN) adalah entitas perbankan syariah baru hasil spin-off Unit Usaha Syariah (UUS) PT Bank Tabungan Negara (Persero) Tbk (BTN) yang resmi beroperasi penuh pada Desember 2025. BSN berfokus pada inovasi digital, termasuk penggunaan aplikasi Bale Syariah , dengan aset sekitar Rp71 triliun dan menargetkan pertumbuhan signifikan sebagai salah satu bank syariah terbesar di Indonesia. BSN berkomitmen menjadi mitra keuangan yang berkah dan amanah, menargetkan nasabah yang membutuhkan layanan perbankan cepat, mudah, dan sesuai prinsip syariah. Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Nasional (BSN) Saat ini PT Bank Syariah Nasional memberikan kesempatan untuk kualifikasi sebagai berikut: Officer Development Program (ODP) Talent Sourcing Melalui Officer Development Program (ODP), Anda akan dipersiapkan menjadi calon pemimpin masa depan Bank Syariah Nasional melalui program pengembangan yang komprehensif dan terstruktur. Sebagai peserta ODP, Anda akan mendapatkan: Program pelatihan intensif (classical training) terkait perbankan syariah, operasional bank, layanan nasabah, serta pengembangan kepemimpinan On-the-Job Training (OJT) melalui rotasi di berbagai unit kerja strategis Pemahaman menyeluruh mengenai produk, layanan, serta prinsip perbankan syariah Pengembangan kompetensi analitis, komunikasi, dan leadership Pendampingan langsung dari mentor dan profesional berpengalaman Kesempatan berkarier dalam lingkungan kerja yang dinamis dengan budaya kerja berbasis integritas, pelayanan, dan kinerja Program ini dirancang untuk membentuk individu yang siap berkontribusi secara optimal dalam mendukung pertumbuhan bisnis serta memberikan layanan terbaik kepada nasabah. Persyaratan Umum: Lulusan Sarjana (S1) dan Magister (S2)
